meta.title: Jason's Project Ecosystem
meta.description: Force-directed map of active projects and integrations

nodes.label: Clarence Bot
nodes.description: Home AI assistant for the Arends household. Listens on Discord, responds to HA voice pipeline, delivers scheduled morning briefings, and controls smart home devices. Built on Claude Sonnet via the Agent SDK.

nodes.label: WeatherBot
nodes.description: AI weather alerting bot monitoring NWS alerts, SPC outlooks, and the home Ambient Weather station. Posts rich embeds to Discord and exposes an MCP server used by Clarence and Home Assistant.

nodes.label: HA Automations
nodes.description: Umbrella repo of Home Assistant automations and companion microservices: NFC-triggered dog-out tracking, chore completion, garage alerts, home/away/vacation mode, and Clarence-triggered morning routines.

nodes.label: Haiku Notify
nodes.description: HACS custom HA integration that wraps any notify service. Rephrases repeated/chained reminders via Claude so they vary in wording and don't sound robotic.

nodes.label: Donetick Scripts
nodes.description: Python scripts and tooling to bulk-manage household chores and pet-care tasks in a self-hosted Donetick instance via its REST API. Tracks dogs-out, laundry, dishes, and other recurring tasks.

nodes.label: MCP Portainer
nodes.description: MCP server that gives any AI assistant (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, etc.) full control over a Portainer instance — containers, stacks, images, networks, and volumes.

nodes.label: FB Specials Scraper
nodes.description: Scrapes Joplin restaurant Facebook pages for daily food specials using Playwright headless Chromium. Classifies the best post with Claude and surfaces results via a local web dashboard and Discord webhook.

nodes.label: dogs.orionis.site
nodes.description: FastAPI web app tracking dog outings by household member. NFC/QR tap → identity picker (remembered by cookie) → logs outing to SQLite → fires HA webhook. Dashboard shows last-out times, overdue alerts, 14-day heatmap, and per-person counts for Goomba, Ace, and Freyja.

nodes.label: chores.orionis.site
nodes.description: FastAPI web app for completing household chores via NFC/QR tag. Tap → identity picker → calls Donetick API to mark complete → fires HA webhook. Dashboard shows due dates, a points leaderboard, and recent completions. /tags page generates printable QR codes for every chore.

nodes.label: NFC / QR Tags
nodes.description: Physical NFC stickers and printed QR codes placed around the house — on dog leash hooks, appliances, etc. Any household member taps or scans to log an action. No app needed; identity is remembered via cookie after first use. The same actions can also be triggered via Clarence or the web dashboard.

nodes.label: Bike Walk Joplin
nodes.description: Community-powered interactive bike and pedestrian safety map for Joplin, MO. Displays city infrastructure, lets residents report hazards with photo upload, and includes a 10-year MSHP crash analysis dashboard.

nodes.label: Discord
nodes.description: Primary notification and chat interface for the home automation ecosystem. Clarence listens here; WeatherBot, HA, and FB Specials all post alerts to Discord channels.

nodes.label: Home Assistant
nodes.description: Local home automation hub running at lvm-ha.orionis.site. Voice pipeline, entity/device control, automation trigger gateway, and host for the Haiku Notify integration.

nodes.label: Claude API
nodes.description: Anthropic's Claude API (Sonnet 4.6 for reasoning, Haiku 4.5 for fast/cheap tasks). Powers Clarence, WeatherBot, Haiku Notify, FB Specials, and MCP Portainer clients.

nodes.label: Trello
nodes.description: Task board. Clarence reads the board as part of the morning brief via its Trello MCP integration.

nodes.label: Google Calendar
nodes.description: Family calendar. Clarence fetches upcoming events as part of morning briefings via service-account integration.

nodes.label: Donetick
nodes.description: Self-hosted chore and pet-care task tracker running at 10.10.200.75:2021 (Docker on qotom-2). REST API consumed by Clarence, HA Automations, and the Donetick Scripts.

nodes.label: Portainer
nodes.description: Docker management platform running most project containers. Clarence, WeatherBot, and FB Specials deploy here via GitOps. MCP Portainer exposes it to AI clients.

nodes.label: NWS / SPC
nodes.description: National Weather Service and Storm Prediction Center APIs. Primary weather alert and forecast data source for WeatherBot.

nodes.label: Ambient Weather
nodes.description: Home weather station. WeatherBot pulls local conditions (temp, humidity, wind, rain) via the aioambient library.

nodes.label: Facebook
nodes.description: FB Specials Scraper hits public restaurant /posts pages via Playwright headless Chromium — no API key, bypasses login overlay.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.description: Cloud storage and Postgres database for Bike Walk Joplin community hazard reports and photo uploads.

nodes.label: ArcGIS / GIS
nodes.description: ArcGIS REST APIs (JATSO, Joplin GIS, NCES, MSHP) providing bike lanes, school locations, and 10-year crash data for the Bike Walk Joplin safety map.
